name: All in one checkout page builder for woocommerce
author: Trusty Plugins

sections.description:
All in One Checkout Page Builder for WooCommerce is the ultimate solution for customizing your WooCommerce checkout page with ease — no coding required.

Create fully customized, conversion-optimized checkout experiences using a visual drag-and-drop builder. Rearrange billing fields, shipping sections, order review, and payment gateways — all from a user-friendly interface.

This plugin empowers store owners to build faster, cleaner, and more intuitive WooCommerce checkout pages that match their brand and boost conversions.

Perfect for developers, marketers, and store owners who want full control over the WooCommerce checkout experience.

✅ Key Features

  • 💡 Visual Drag & Drop Builder – Design your checkout layout visually with instant feedback.
  • 🎨 Custom Layouts – Create one or multiple checkout templates with different field arrangements.
  • 🧾 Edit Billing & Shipping Fields – Add, remove, or reorder fields without touching code.
  • 🔄 Live Preview – See changes reflected instantly on your checkout page.
  • 📦 Order Review & Payment Blocks – Drag and position core checkout elements freely.
  • 🖼️ Pre-made Layouts – Use or customize included layout templates to save time.
  • 🌐 Multi-Device Compatible – Mobile-friendly and responsive by default.
  • ⚡ Lightweight & Fast – Optimized for performance and clean output.
  • 🔌 Seamlessly Integrates with WooCommerce – Works out of the box with core WooCommerce functionality.
  • 🧩 Extendable – Designed with developers in mind for easy customization.
sections.installation:
1. Install The Dependencies

Before getting started, ensure you have the Woocommerce installed and activated.

2. Upload the Plugin:

  • Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  • From the left-hand menu, go to Plugins > Add New.
  • After selecting the file, click Install Now.

3. Activate the Plugin:

  • Once the installation is complete, click the Activate Plugin button.

Open wordpress settings menu and find sub menu ‘Trusty Checkout’.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with all standard WooCommerce-compatible themes. For best results, use a theme that follows WooCommerce coding standards. If you face layout issues, you can always customize using the builder or override with custom CSS.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

Not at all. The plugin is built with performance in mind. It loads only on the checkout page and uses optimized, lightweight scripts.

Can I create multiple checkout templates?

Yes. You can create and manage multiple checkout templates. This allows you to switch between different layouts or test what works best for your store.

Can I reorder or remove WooCommerce billing and shipping fields?

Absolutely. You can add, remove, or reorder billing and shipping fields using the drag-and-drop interface — no coding needed.

Is coding knowledge required to use this plugin?

No. This plugin is made for everyone — whether you’re a beginner or an advanced developer. Everything is visual and intuitive.

Does it support order review, coupon, and payment sections?

Yes. You can drag and drop the order review, payment, and coupon modules wherever you like on the checkout page.

Is this plugin translation-ready?

Yes, all plugin strings are translation-ready and follow WordPress internationalization standards.

Can I use this plugin with Elementor, Divi, or other page builders?

This plugin specifically replaces and enhances the WooCommerce checkout template. It works independently of page builders and is compatible with any builder-based theme.

How do I activate a layout on the live checkout page?

After designing your layout, simply mark it as “Active Template” from the layout list. That template will be applied automatically to the live checkout page.

Where can I get support or report a bug?

You can use the WordPress.org support forum, or visit our support portal. We’re always happy to help!
